title: Webhooks
description: URLs your tools call to trigger your automations.

empty.title: No webhooks
empty.description: A webhook receives notifications from an external tool (Stripe payment, form submitted…). Each call becomes an event that can start a workflow.

card.produces: Produces the {event} event, signed with the {secret} credential.

delete.title: Delete the “{name}” webhook?
delete.description: The URL will stop responding: tools calling it will get an error. Workflows using it will no longer trigger.

create.title: New webhook
create.description: A URL your tools (Stripe, forms, CRM…) call to notify the platform of an event.
create.name: Name
create.eventHint: Name of the event that will trigger your workflows.
create.secretHint: Name of a credential (Credentials page) holding the signing key provided by the tool.
